newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks close sharply down, index below 14,000.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks close sharply down, index below 14,000.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks nose dived on Thursday and the Hang Seng Index closed below 14,000 for the first time since May 13 as sentiment turned bearish on concerns about local property and China's stock markets, brokers said.
The Hang Seng Index plunged 497.18 points, or 3.45 percent, to finish at 13,924.34. Turnover was HK$17.43 billion compared to HK$17.51 billion on Wednesday.
"Major brokerages turned bearish on Hong Kong stocks, some funds are seen unloading their holdings and sentiment as a whole is weak," said Henry Lui, research analyst at Mansion House Research.
